title: AI caught my wrong-airport taxi
hook: AI was the reason I worked out I'd booked a taxi to the wrong airport.
summary: AI travel planning in Notion just saved my flight home.
body: AI travel planning in Notion just saved my flight home.

I connected my Notion OS to my itinerary, flights and bookings. At the bottom of the trip page it listed the usual checks (passport, packing), then added: "check your taxi on this day, I think you're going to the wrong airport."
It was right. My return taxi was booked to the wrong airport.
I don't let the agents action anything yet. They just flag it to me, and that was enough.
Comment "connect" and I'll send you how I set it up.
